title: The boat pits as acid-filled circuit breakers

tellings.quote: So inside the boat pits adjacent to the Great Pyramid, we find more sulfate compounds.

plain: Geoffrey Drumm believes the boat pits beside the Great Pyramid, long trenches cut into the rock, were once filled with acid and worked as circuit breakers for a pyramid that he thinks was a machine. He tells Michels he has found "more sulfate compounds" inside them as evidence, and says on the show that the pyramids' true purpose was revealed to him by an alien.
